read.thesis: Software re-accelerated to 9% with about a quarter from slipped deals; TP rebounded to 10%, but management now calls double-digit TP non-recurring and guides TP flat for the year, so the beat is partly timing.

triggers.label: Software growth 5% → 9%
triggers.quote: Software revenue growth accelerated four points sequentially to 9% this quarter, including over four points of organic growth.

triggers.label: Slip deals ~$250M+ of growth
triggers.quote: We closed two-thirds of those. That's $250-plus million. That is the 25% of the contribution of the growth that we've had of 4 points.

triggers.label: Software FY guide raised to ~7-8%
triggers.quote: We now expect full-year software growth of approximately 7%-8%, with about 7% as the revised base case.

triggers.label: TP moderating from 3Q
triggers.quote: I do not expect double-digit performance in TP to keep going, but I would expect to see now more normalized performance

guidance.quote: We continue to expect revenue growth for 2026 in the range of 4%-5%
we are raising our expectation for free cash flow growth to more than $1 billion
We now expect full-year software growth of approximately 7%-8%, with about 7% as the revised base case.
For transaction processing, we are raising our expectations for the full year, with growth expected to be flat.
we continue to expect low double-digit infrastructure revenue growth for the full year
backlog quality and momentum in GenAI continue to support a modest acceleration to low to mid-single digit revenue growth for the year.
We continue to expect 100 basis points of operating pre-tax margin expansion for the full year
we are comfortable about double-digit growth in the fourth quarter of this year

prior_guidance_check.quote: We continue to expect revenue growth for 2026 in the range of 4%-5%

prior_guidance_check.metric: Transaction processing down low to mid-single digits in 2H
prior_guidance_check.quote: Last quarter, you were thinking that TP might be down low to mid-single digits for the second half, and you called it a 27 growth vector. It grew 10% instead.
We continue to expect 100 basis points of operating pre-tax margin expansion for the full year

red_flags.label: TP growth driven by slipped deals and timing
red_flags.quote: I would be candid and tell you, I do not expect double-digit performance in TP to keep going

red_flags.label: Consulting margin declined
red_flags.quote: Consulting segment profit margin declined modestly as we reinvested productivity gains into digital assets

evasions.quote: Right now, we do not really want to comment on 2027 growth

evasions.topic: Long-term double-digit software target and M&A role
evasions.quote: We'll quantify that in January, but that gives you a little bit of perspective of our early thinking about 2027
